requiredFindings.summary: Price the actual BTreeMap lookup comparisons conservatively.
requiredFindings.detail: crates/host/src/component_admission.rs charges each BTreeMap::get with manifest::probe_reference_comparisons(m), the binary-search bound ceil(log2(m)) + 1. Rust 1.95 linearly scans keys within B-tree nodes of capacity 11. The real nine-field release row can therefore require six comparisons for publisher and seven for sourceClass while the candidate charges only five. Replace this with a proven bound or an explicitly charged search, and add a late-key/insufficient-bound control with one-unit-short refusal evidence.
